answer: The relic I would price into every new account is Proof of unique driver license test record: a test passed at one centre, on record for years, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. A farm that reuses one proof across ten accounts is caught at the second account, because a test passed at one centre, on record for years is bound to a single identity — the forge is that reuse itself becomes the evidence. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the inlet for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
